_comment: Phase 8 Stage 1 buildable-structure catalog (ROADMAP.md 'Building, Settlement Expansion & Fencing System'), grown from Phase 4 Stage 2's 2-entry proof-of-mechanic set to the full 12-building library. Loaded by scripts/building_db.gd, same shape/conventions as data/items.json + scripts/item_db.gd. New optional, backward-additive fields per entry: interaction ("" | "storage" | "trading_post" - replaces the old is_storage bool; storage_shed migrated to "interaction": "storage"), daily_yield ({item_id: count} added to player inventory once per in-game day via structures.gd's day-tick, generically - no per-building code), capacity_unlock ({bonus_key: amount} one-time bonuses summed via scripts/building_effects.gd's recompute_capacity_unlocks, recomputed in FULL every time rather than incrementally applied), and effect (a string key into scripts/building_effects.gd's EFFECTS registry of bespoke per-tick callables, or a key read directly by a later stage's own logic - Watchtower/Antenna Tower's effect strings aren't tick callables, they're read by Stage 3's settler-arrival roll). Fields: kind keys scripts/structures.gd's BUILDING_COLORS flat-color placeholder table; size is [w, h] in 16px cells; cost items are deliberately limited to wood/stone/scrap_metal because those are the only resources the player can actually gather in-game right now (axe on a tree yields 3 wood; pickaxe on ore yields 2 stone + 1 scrap_metal - see scripts/farm.gd) - cloth_scrap/bottle_caps/fertilizer exist in items.json but have no gather source yet, so costing them would make a structure unbuildable. Sizing/build_days convention for the 10 new entries (Stage 1 plan): 1x1 kinds (Compost Pit, Rain Collector, Solar Panel) = 1 day; 2x2 kinds (Workshop, Clinic, Greenhouse, Watchtower) = 2 days; larger civic kinds (Trading Post, Community Kitchen, 3x2; Antenna Tower, 1x1 but complex to erect) = 3 days. Cost tuning for the 10 new entries is a fresh back-of-envelope balance pass (not derived from any external source): scaled roughly with build_days/footprint, using only wood/stone/scrap_metal per the constraint above, with each kind's material mix nodding at its theme (Rain Collector/Antenna Tower lean scrap for piping/wiring; Clinic/Community Kitchen lean stone for solid civic walls). shelter_tent (display name now "Shelter Cabin") and storage_shed (display name now "Storage Barn") keep their original kind/size/cost/build_days exactly - only the display name and the is_storage->interaction schema migration changed, specifically to avoid disturbing the existing place->spend->wait-a-day and chest-storage regression coverage (tools/runtime_smoke.gd, tools/soak_test.gd) that pins those two buildings' exact costs/day-counts.
